name: install-agent-config
description: Governance rules, skills and commands for AI coding agents in Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI — install or upgrade the full event4u agent-config suite. No plugin that ships this pointer is the full suite (the Claude Code one adds hooks, the Copilot one a read-only MCP server); ALL content installs via `npx -y @event4u/agent-config init`. Use when the user asks to install, set up, or upgrade agent-config, wants coding-agent rules or skills, or wonders why this plugin contains no other skills.
